Lady Annalie: Here comes my best client!
You: Best client? Why?
Lady Annalie: Well, you are one of the best for sure.
Lady Annalie: You left here quite a fortune, you know?
You: Come on, it can’t be that bad. You make it sound like I’m addicted or something.
Lady Annalie: You have spent more than {f_Integer}$ for sure! 
Lady Annalie: Don’t get me wrong, I’m not complaining~ 
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: I love money ♥
Maybe I should stop coming here after all.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: I can tell from your expression that you thought about something rude again. Just so you know, that was just a joke.
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: I love big butts more~
You: I hope that’s also a joke…
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: I will leave that to your imagination.
